REAL PIPELINE BUG FOUND: resolveTypedDate has no "tomorrow" pattern at all (resolveRelativeDate's regex set only covers today/yesterday/day-before-yesterday/N-days-ago/weekday phrases/"on the Nth" — never a future date, by design: typed expenses are assumed to be in the past). So resolveTypedDate(text, now) returns null and deviceParse.ts's `?? now` fallback files this as TODAY (2026-02-28), silently dropping the user's explicit "tomorrow". The label here is the human intent (2026-03-01), per M2's instruction to keep the human label and flag the disagreement rather than mirror the resolver's wrong answer — so this case is EXPECTED to fail dateISO against both the heuristic and FM today; it exists to make the gap visible, not to pass.
